message.content: In computer vision, purple is typically represented as a combination of red and blue wavelengths. It can be used to test algorithms for color detection, segmentation, or object recognition. For example, a computer vision system might be trained to identify purple objects in an image by looking for pixels that have high red and blue values but low green values. This helps evaluate how well the system can distinguish colors that are not pure primary colors.
